## SMBsync+ 2.55-plus.13

- Activity now saves every source filename checked during a sync, including files skipped because they already exist at the destination.
- Each new run shows a short file list on its Activity card. Tap the card to browse the complete list in the app.
- File lists are saved separately for each run and removed when its history entry is deleted.
- Runs made before this update continue to show their available summary information.

The APK is built and signed by GitHub Actions with the same certificate as previous SMBsync+ releases. It can install over them without removing saved settings.

SMBsync+ is based on [SMBSync2 by Sentaroh](https://github.com/Sentaroh/SMBSync2). Source and license notices remain in this repository.
